craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Jar-yet-burn; brow-eye shows; they-teach plural kept. Rejected: (a) jar→shake → killed: jar jars. Read aloud: FOR-self-PLEASED FULL-ones … SU-preme-FIRE-formed THEY-teach.

lines: For self-pleased full ones — though sense-bubbles jar —
what burns desire — brow-eye showing — supreme-fire-formed they teach.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svātmārāmamayānāṃ viṣamā api viṣayabudbudhāḥ kim amī smaradahanam alikanayanam prathayan paramāgnirūpam ādiśasi

reads_against.argmap: What burns before the brow-eye? → Bubbles adverse; brow-eye burning shown supreme-fire.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
